Her hair is swept up and crowned with a cascading arrangement of fresh real roses in blush and cream, petals softly overlapping in a natural organic crown. Warm soft afternoon golden light bathes the entire scene from a low angle, creating luminous golden shadows across the stone fountain, honeyed highlights on the silk taffeta, and a dreamily warm overall atmosphere. Mood: romantic, sensuous, timeless — evoking the best pages of One Thousand and One Nights. Shot on Hasselblad H6D medium format, inspired by Paolo Roversi's painterly soft-focus aesthetic and Christian Dior couture campaign directions.
